name: State files are written atomically
prose: `settings.json`, `graph.json`, `symbols.json`, `profiles.json` and `config.json` all go through one write-then-rename helper per half of the app. `settings.json` has two writers (the engine and the app), and the app SIGKILLs the engine 3s into a shutdown: a truncated file reads as "no settings", which presents as a workspace that lost its endpoint and key.
